lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, with significantly higher density and narrower inter-line distance observed at the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: A prominent white dash is visible at the vertical midpoint between the 5th and 6th primary lines. A smaller white fleck is situated on the lower flank between the 4th and 5th lines. The anterior-most line is abbreviated and does not traverse the full verticality of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: One primary high-contrast white spot is located on the lower haunch, superior to the popliteal region of the hind limb. No further clustering is visible.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white bands on the distal limbs above the hoof. White patch on the ventral throat. White facial markings localized between the eyes. High-contrast white fringe along the interior pinnae.
